name: divan
description: Codex-native engineering workflows for scoped implementation, quality review, debugging, and evidence-based delivery.

interface.longDescription: Divan helps Codex inspect a repository, plan bounded changes, debug root causes, review engineering quality, and verify completion with observed evidence. It keeps the technical machinery behind a simple natural-language workflow for builders.
defaultPrompt: Inspect this repository and identify the highest-value engineering risks.
Plan and implement the smallest correct change for this task.
Review this change and verify whether it is actually ready to ship.
